tools.name: flights_one_way_price
tools.description: Shows cheapest one-way flight prices across a date range. Returns daily prices with price band thresholds for comparison. Use with origin/destination IATA codes from places_find_location. Defaults to next 6 months if no dates provided.

tools.name: flights_schedule
tools.description: Gets the current published timetable of nonstop flights between two cities: airlines, flight numbers, departure and arrival airports and times, duration, and operating periods (dates, weekdays and aircraft). Connecting flights are not listed: use flights_search for those and for fares on a date. Acc

tools.name: flights_search_anywhere
tools.description: Discovers cheapest flight destinations from an origin city when the user has no specific destination in mind. Use for open-ended queries like 'where should I go?', 'cheapest flights from Dubai', 'surprise me', or 'best deals from Singapore'. Returns up to 15 cheapest destinations with prices, airlin

tools.name: places_get_nearest_airport
tools.description: Finds the nearest airport to given coordinates. Returns airport IATA code, name, and distance. Useful for determining departure airport when only coordinates are known.

tools.name: holidays_lookup
tools.description: Looks up public holidays for a country within a date range. Used for travel planning to find local holidays at the destination.

tools.name: hotels_get_photos
tools.description: Gets photos for one or more hotels (up to 8), up to 3 per category: rooms, bathrooms, dining, amenities such as the pool and gym, public spaces such as the lobby, exterior, views and nearby attractions. Hotels with no categories get up to 12 photos with no category. Use this tool for room photos too

tools.name: hotels_get_rooms
tools.description: Gets room rates for a specific hotel. Returns room types with pricing from multiple providers. Each rate's perNight price covers all rooms in the search together, for one night. Requires hotelId and searchId from a prior hotels_search call. If status is "incomplete", more rates are still loading: wa
